about_the_game:
Your character is a programmer who goes into top-down digital reality to defeat the rebellious AI. But on the way you meet many of his minions. But in the digital scape there are not only enemies but also allies and many guys ready to help or just chill with you.

Fight agains mad NPCs:

The professor who sent you gave you a sword to fight mad NPCs, but that's not the only weapon you can use. Remember that your lives are not infinite, use flash drives with hearts (med kits) and other buffs to win.

Or make friend with them:

Not all NPCs are hostile, some are friendly, and some are your allies in the fight against the mad AI. You can contact them, help them, and become friends.

Solve puzzles and riddles:

Solve puzzles to open a path, gain access to a computer (yes, to a computer inside a digital reality) or for any other purpose that lore requires.

Glitches and weird creatures:

Since this is an artificial world, there may be glitches and weird creatures in here which for some reason were not removed
